_about: The Enhanced lighting tune (src/Session/World/LightingTable.cs), read only under Enhanced graphics. Keyed chapter, then an optional mission folder, then weather zone ('ZONE1' to 'ZONE3' as the mission's weather.json authors them), e.g. {"C5": {"ZONE1": {"exposure": 1.1}, "M02": {"night": true, "ZONE1": {"sun_energy": 1.2}}}}. A chapter zone block holds only the fields that differ from the defaults; a mission zone block only those that differ from its chapter's. A mission's 'night' flag makes it a moonlit mission (CONTEXT.md): every zone takes the night path, the capped energies and the light aimed at the dome's moon. The field names, ranges and meanings are ZoneLighting.Fields (src/Effects/ZoneLighting.cs). The lighting lab (Shift+F4 in --freecam) writes one zone here when run from the source tree; --debug-lighting=<field>:<value>,... overrides it for one launch. An empty file draws the untuned Enhanced look.
